wellnessMeditationSubtitle: Guided breathing, nadi shodhana and Om chanting
wellnessSessionDone: Session complete. Notice how you feel.
wellnessPatternBoxInfo: Equal counts of inhaling, holding, exhaling and holding. Steadies the mind.
wellnessPattern478Info: Inhale for 4, hold for 7, exhale for 8. Often used to relax before sleep.
wellnessPatternNadiInfo: Alternate-nostril breathing from yoga. Close the right nostril with the right thumb to inhale on the left; close the left with the ring finger to exhale on the right; then reverse.
wellnessPatternOmInfo: Inhale deeply, then chant a long "Ommm" on the exhale, feeling the vibration.
wellnessThemeSun: steady confidence; try a sunrise practice
wellnessThemeMars: energy and courage; try box breathing
wellnessThemeMercury: clarity and focus; try nadi shodhana
wellnessThemeJupiter: gratitude and wisdom; try Om chanting
wellnessThemeSaturn: patience and grounding; try a longer box breathing session
wellnessHealthNote: Stop if you feel dizzy or uncomfortable. If you have a medical condition, check with a doctor before breath-holding practices.
